leo: FYI onboarding novaq-int4-preview (canary) is showing a spike in funcall schema failures when args contain emoji / supplementary-plane chars.
priya: Any concrete example we can inspect?
leo: router log snippet: 
```
{"tool":"send_message","args":"{\"text\":\"こんにちは 👋🏼 — meeting at 3pm\",\"meta\":{\"tz\":\"UTC\"}}"}
```
ana: So args is a JSON-encoded string instead of an object. Validator expects object -> rejects.
leo: Root cause hypothesis: streaming chunk boundary splits a UTF surrogate pair (skin-tone modifier) while kv-prefix caching is on. Model emits a partial escape like "\ud83d" then later "\ude0a"; generation policy ends up quoting the embedded JSON, producing a stringified payload.
replay-bot: Replay summary: 37 failures in last 2h; 71% correlate with emoji/supplementary-plane occurences.
evals-bot: novaq-int4-preview | funcall-schema-pass: 58% | baseline fp16: 91% | sample N=400 | top errors: args_stringified (49%), parse_truncate (30%).
priya: Short-term mitigation: validator performs a single-layer json.loads if args is a string and looks like JSON (startswith{"{","["}), and tag telemetry label "unwrapped_args". Add strict caps: max 256KB and no control chars.
leo: + add debug capture of raw token stream for 100 failed requests to verify where surrogate splits occur.
ana: Medium-term: avoid slicing inside surrogate pairs at the streaming encoder level and add a kernel/tokenizer anchor fix for int4 paths. File runtime ticket.
priya: Also change retry/dedupe: if parse fails after ack, mark as parse-fail and schedule deduped retry with idempotency key instead of immediate re-invoke. Reduces duplicate tool calls.
infra-bot: deploy requested: novaq-int4-canary-unescape-2026-03-23 by leo -> rolling to 3% traffic.
leo: I'll add unit tests fuzzing nested arrays + emoji + RTL text.
priya: Re-eval in 30m. If schema_pass doesn't hit >=80% we'll rollback. :thumbsup:
